craft_notes: Sthāyin: reception — completing u28's sentence. Rows: station then passing. Rejected: ablative doubt — killed: adjudicated (pragṛhyate governs). Read aloud: arrival breath.

lines: In the eastward seat, firm in the unparted station, outflow-robed —
the risen too is passed from mouth to mouth, from the chief mouth outward.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prācyāṃ visargasattām anavacchidite pade rūḍhāḥ uditaṃ ca mitho vaktrān mukhyād vaktre pragṛhyate ca bahiḥ
